detection.sql:
WITH b AS (SELECT order_ts::DATE AS d, region, channel, category, customer_segment, SUM(gross_amount-discount_amount-returns_amount) AS num, SUM(order_multiplicity) AS den FROM commerce.orders GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5)
SELECT d, region, channel, category, SUM(num) AS value, SUM(num) AS numerator, SUM(den) AS denominator
FROM b
WHERE region IN ('WEST','NORTH','SOUTH','EAST')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY 1
